column1: Data from animal 1 showing how the coefficient of error (CE) for the estimate of cell number in gray matter was calculated
F = number of fields where cells were counted. P = number of points falling on the transverse sections. Q⁻ = number of cells counted in the oblique sections.
The latter is used only for estimating CE, while the first is used for the unbiased estimate of cell number (see ref. 32).
